description: This file defines the StorelessUnivariateStatistic interface, which extends UnivariateStatistic with methods for updating internal statistical calculations incrementally, suitable for online or streaming data processing. It also includes method signatures for adding individual or multiple values, retrieving the current statistic, and copying the instance.

classes.name: StorelessUnivariateStatistic
classes.description: Interface for univariate statistics that can be updated incrementally without storing all sample values, enabling efficient computations on streaming data.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Updates the internal state of the statistic to reflect the addition of a new value.

methods.name: incrementAll
methods.description: Adds multiple values to the statistic's internal state, either from an array or a segment of an array.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the current value of the statistic.

methods.name: getN
methods.description: Returns the total number of values added to the statistic.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the statistic.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the statistic with the same internal state.
